82 condos sold in Marpole with a median price of $613,500 (the middle half sold between $509,750 and $786,250), taking a median of 38 days to sell at 96.0% of the last list price; 1% sold above list. items.t: Marpole is both an MLS sub-area name and a City local area. The City's Marpole Community Plan area is bounded by Angus Drive, West 57th Avenue, Ontario Street and the Fraser River, about 1,386 acres.
Five arterials cross Marpole: Granville Street, Oak Street, Cambie Street, SW Marine Drive and West 70th Avenue.
Granville Street is the neighbourhood's main shopping street and holds the Marpole Library.
Council approved the Marpole Community Plan on April 2, 2014.
At the time of the plan, about 10,100 homes, 55% apartments and 56% rented.
Plan land-use designations range from townhouse and rowhouse (up to 3 storeys) through apartments of 4, 6 or 8 storeys to mixed use up to 12 storeys.
Council approved Marine Landing policy updates on December 8, 2021, guiding rezoning for affordable housing and employment sites near Marine Drive Station.

blocks.text: Marpole: parks, community facilities and shopping

items.t: The plan names parks including William Mackie, Oak, Winona, Riverview, Marpole, Eburne, Ash, Ebisu, Shannon and Fraser River Park.
Marpole-Oakridge Community Centre is at 59th Avenue and Oak Street, with a gym, fitness centre, tennis court and the water park at Oak Park.
The plan's public benefits strategy calls for a renewed community centre and library and new childcare spaces.
The plan names Sexsmith Elementary, Laurier Elementary, Laurier Annex, David Lloyd George Elementary and Churchill Secondary.
Canada Line Marine Drive Station opened in 2009, per the plan. TransLink lists it between Langara-49th Avenue and Bridgeport.
TransLink's weekday peak 80 Marine Drive Express links River District with Marine Drive Station.

blocks.text: Marpole: risks and rules a buyer should know

items.t: Rental: the 2014 plan reported 97% of rental units covered by Rate of Change regulations and a goal of protecting affordable rental in the Hudson sub-area. The City now states the Tenant Relocation and Protection Policy replaced the Rate of Change Guidelines for applications received from February 15, 2016.

Under that policy, redevelopment of purpose-built rental needs a tenant relocation plan, compensation of 4 to 24 months' rent depending on tenancy length, and a right to return at a 20% discount to starting market rent.
Empty Homes Tax: annual declaration; 3% of assessed value for properties deemed or declared empty in the 2025 reference year (page as retrieved Nov 2026).

faq.q: What did condos in Marpole sell for?
faq.a: 82 condos sold in Marpole between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $613,500.

faq.q: How long do condos take to sell in Marpole?
faq.a: The median was 38 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.0% of the last list price (1% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most condos in Marpole sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 82 condos that sold in Marpole went for between $509,750 and $786,250, around a median of $613,500.

faq.q: Do condos in Marpole sell above asking price?
faq.a: 1% of the 82 condos sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 96.0% of it.

faq.q: What is a typical strata fee for condos in Marpole?
faq.a: Of the 82 sales, 82 listings gave a monthly fee and the median was $501.

faq.q: How old are the condos that sold in Marpole?
faq.a: The median year built was 2018 for the 82 condos sold in Marpole.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do condos in Marpole usually have?
faq.a: The median condo that sold in Marpole had 2 bedrooms, from the 82 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
